data.long_meaning: Ethel- 'noble' + dreda 'powerful leader'; derived from Æthelthryth, an Anglo-Saxon queen and later saint who was known for her noble rule and strong leadership. The name Etheldreda carries the meaning “Noble, powerful leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Etheldreda usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, powerful leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אתלדרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אתלדרה הוא שם פרטי נוצרי שמקורו באנגלית העתיקה, ומשמעותו 'שושנת האדמה' או 'פרח האדמה'. השם מורכב משני חלקים: 'אדל' שפירושו 'אציל' ו-'תדרה' שפירושו 'עץ' או 'שושנת'. השם אתלדרה היה נפוץ באנגליה בימי הביניים, והוא קשור לסנט אתלדרה, קדושה אנגלית מהמאה ה-7.

in_greek.name: Εθελδρήδη
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Εθελδρήδη είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την παλιά αγγλική γλώσσα. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος είναι από τις λέξεις 'æthel' που σημαίνει 'ευγενής' και 'þrēo' που σημαίνει 'δέντρο' ή 'άνθος'. Η Αγία Εθελδρήδη ήταν μία αγγλίδα καλόγρια και ηγουμένη του 7ου αιώνα, γνωστή για την πνευματική της ζωή και το έργο της.

in_latin.name: Etheldreda
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Etheldreda origine Anglosaxonicum est, significans 'potestas terrae' vel 'flos terrae'. Compositum est ex duobus partibus: 'æthel', quod 'nobilis' significat, et 'þrēo', quod 'dendrum' seu 'florem' denotat. S. Etheldreda, sancta Angliae saeculi VII, fuerat nobili familia natus et vita monastica clara.

in_english.name: Etheldreda
in_english.meaning: Noble strength or flower of the earth
in_english.long_meaning: Etheldreda is a Christian name of Old English origin, meaning 'noble strength' or 'flower of the earth'. It is derived from the Anglo-Saxon words 'æthel', meaning 'noble', and 'þrēo', meaning 'tree' or 'blossom'. The name Etheldreda was popularized by St. Etheldreda, an English saint and abbess of the 7th century, known for her piety and devotion to God. The name symbolizes spiritual growth, humility, and connection to nature.

data.cultural_impact: The name Etheldreda carries a rich cultural significance as it is derived from the historic Anglo-Saxon queen and saint, Æthelthryth. She is a significant figure in English history and has been the subject of numerous legends and literary works. Her reputation as a powerful leader and noble ruler has influenced the ways in which the name Etheldreda is perceived.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Etheldreda also holds spiritual significance, as it was borne by a saint whose life was marked by great faith, devotion, and miracles. According to legend, Æthelthryth was a beautiful and pious princess who dedicated her life to God and founded the monastery of Ely, where she lived as a recluse and performed many miracles. She is now known as Saint Etheldreda, and her reputation as a holy and powerful woman continues to inspire and influence those who bear her name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Etheldreda, meaning "noble of noble ones," embodies the virtuous and noble spirit of early Christian saints. Her name is a testament to the enduring strength and dignity of those who dedicated their lives to the faith during challenging times.
